verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS security and compliance platform that holds customer data and uses AI agents (Fieldwork), so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy for AI. The MCP/OAuth scoping and RBAC docs only cover access control, a related but different capability, so they earn no credit here.
